items.text: After a successful yt-dlp probe, Agent-Reach YouTube readiness checks for Deno or Node. In the Node-present, Deno-absent branch, _has_js_runtime_config calls read_small_text_no_follow with max_bytes=1024*1024 and checks the returned text for the literal substring --js-runtimes. It does not parse or validate the flag's effective value; the reading helper was not inspected. Missing that substring leads to a warn branch.

Agent-Reach YouTube readiness invokes probe_command for yt-dlp with [--version], timeout=10 and package=yt-dlp. A missing probe status yields off; broken or another non-ok probe yields error. It does not download a video in this check.

Agent-Reach RSS readiness imports feedparser. ImportError yields off; another import-time exception yields error; a successful import yields ok and selects feedparser. This check does not fetch a feed.
Agent-Reach Web check selects Jina Reader and returns the literal status ok without a network request. This readiness result does not prove that Jina Reader or any target page was retrieved.
